reason: The generic CRUD routes called after_write without awaiting it. Since #939 made HarnessQuotaObserver.schedule_read async, every harness profile create/put/patch through the execution kernel's routes dropped a never-awaited coroutine and no Butler quota read ran. The routes now await a maybe-async after_write via call_async. Selected: the harness and OpenRouter Butler resource suites (including the new regression test and the provider-setup credit check through the same route), the generic CRUD exposure guard, harness quota reads, and the SQL-only global API that serves production profile writes.
exclusions: test_butler_resources.py::test_ordinary_openrouter_completion_checks_credits_after_exchange_commit and ::test_native_mission_attempt_usage_signals_account_check_after_commit fail identically on pristine origin/main (fixture leftovers from #939, repaired separately in #1011) and are excluded. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed. In production, profile writes go api_worker -> GlobalSqlDelivery -> RuntimeGlobalApi, whose CRUD routes register no after_write, so this change does not alter production behaviour; see the PR's limitations.
